doc.title: Ellis Marsalis interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Orleans, Louisiana, January 7, 2020

title: Segregated bands and jam sessions; first integrated band with Al Hirt
summary: Bands and jam sessions were not integrated; his first integrated band was with Al Hirt in 1967.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: Were the groups that you played with around that time, the early 50s, were they integrated?
When was the first time that you played in an integrated band rather than a jam session, like a real gig?
The jam session wasn’t integrated either.
Was there a black and a white jam session that you could go to? I mean —
Not in them days. I think the first band that I played with which could be considered an integrated band was when I started playing with Al Hirt. But that was in ’67. But before that no.
